# Introduction

Welcome to Malachyte Docs

These docs cover everything needed to set up, use, and grow with Malachyte. From onboarding guides to in-depth technical references, these docs are here to help client teams work faster and smarter.

[**Install Malachyte directly in a Shopify store** \\
A step-by-step guide to integrate Malachyte and Shopify.](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/shopify/overview) [**Integrate Malachyte with a headless system** \\
Step-by-step guides to set up Malachyte with a headless storefront.](https://docs.malachyte.com/get-started/headless) [**Get started with Malachyte Recommend** \\
Create custom recommendation carousels throughout the site.](https://docs.malachyte.com/how-it-works/recommend/overview) [**Get started with Malachyte Search** \\
Set up a dynamic search experience that personalizes to shopper inputs and context.](https://docs.malachyte.com/how-it-works/search/overview) [**Get started with Malachyte Pages** \\
Control how products are ranked, filtered, and merchandised on collection pages.](https://docs.malachyte.com/how-it-works/plp/overview)
